items.finding: v0.1 conflated applicability with evidence sufficiency through `not_evidenced` feature and applicability states.
items.resolution: v0.2 separates feature, applicability, and evidence-state vocabularies.

items.finding: ASR001-D03-C02 was metadata-bound to human-performance claims and could miss autonomous execution after human design.
items.resolution: Applicability changes to `when_feature_present` with the existing agency-regime trigger.

items.finding: ASR001-D04-C02 could not cleanly cover biological-control or support contexts without presuming settled human-performance classification.
items.resolution: Applicability changes to `when_feature_present`; athletic membership remains unresolved.

items.finding: A JSON profile could mark machine-readable distribution absent although the instance itself is machine-readable.
items.resolution: The v0.2 JSON schema fixes the distribution feature to `present`.

items.finding: v0.1 required evidence references for every applicable clause, creating artificial duplication for declarative and lifecycle metadata.
items.resolution: v0.2 adds evidence-requirement classes and permits declaration or lifecycle records where appropriate.

items.finding: Profile supersession was not explicit in v0.1 metadata.
items.resolution: v0.2 adds supersedes and superseded-by identifiers plus structured correction records.

items.finding: D12 remains useful across autonomous, support, and contest trials when it permits explicit not-applicable or unknown disclosures rather than invented safety claims.
D05-C02 correctly preserves unknown, disputed, and not-applicable topology without inventing remote technical tolerances.
items.resolution: No clause change; applicability–evidence separation improves representation.
